title: Exceptions to spendthrift provision.
bodyText:
(a) A spendthrift provision is unenforceable against:

(1) A beneficiary's child who has a judgment or court order against the beneficiary for support or maintenance; and

(2) A claim of this State or the United States to the extent a law of this State or federal law so provides.

(b) A claimant against which a spendthrift provision cannot be enforced may obtain from a court an order attaching present or future distributions to or for the benefit of the beneficiary. The court may limit the award to relief as is appropriate under the circumstances.

[§554D-503]  Exceptions to spendthrift provision.  (a)  A spendthrift provision is unenforceable against:

     (1)  A beneficiary's child who has a judgment or court order against the beneficiary for support or maintenance; and

     (2)  A claim of this State or the United States to the extent a law of this State or federal law so provides.

     (b)  A claimant against which a spendthrift provision cannot be enforced may obtain from a court an order attaching present or future distributions to or for the benefit of the beneficiary.  The court may limit the award to relief as is appropriate under the circumstances. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
